in_sanskrit.name: Basava
in_sanskrit.meaning: Lord of Basha, Lord of the Forest
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Basava is derived from the Sanskrit words 'bas', meaning 'lord', and 'vash', meaning 'Basha' or 'Forest'. Therefore, the name Basava means 'Lord of Basha' or 'Lord of the Forest'. The name Basavaraju is a variation of this name, meaning 'servant of Basava' or 'devotee of Basava'.

in_hindi.name: वासवराजू
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Basavaraju is derived from the name Basava, which is a common name in Karnataka, India. In Hindi, the name Basavaraju can be translated to 'वासुदेवका दास' (Vasudevaka dās) or 'वासुदेव के दास' (Vasudev ke dās), meaning 'servant of Basava' or 'devotee of Basava'.

in_tamil.name: பாசவராஜு
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Basavaraju in Tamil can be translated to 'பாசவன் அருள்வார்' (Pāsavaṉ arulvār), meaning 'servant of Basava' or 'devotee of Basava'.

in_telugu.name: బాశవరాజు
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Basavaraju in Telugu can be translated to 'బాశవన్నీదేశ్యుదు' (Bāśavan nīdēśyudu), meaning 'servant of Basava' or 'devotee of Basava'.
